comment: S30 Phase A generic few-shot set. 5 hand-curated library pairs covering let_rec, match_list, foldl with accumulator, method_chain, and two-list filter. Same set is reused for all 12 held_out_12 tasks and all 3 Phase A models (Qwen-1.5B, Qwen-7B, Claude Opus 4.6). Deliberately generic and not task-specific — Phase A measures a lower bound on base-model capability. If Phase A + B-3 oracle retrieval both miss, the plan reads the gate as 'not solvable by current-gen model scale'. Frozen before any run.

pairs.name: List.partition
pairs.state:
p : ℤ → Bool
as : List ℤ
⊢ List ℤ × List ℤ
pairs.tactic: exact let rec loop : List Int → List Int × List Int → List Int × List Int | [], (bs, cs) => (bs.reverse, cs.reverse) | a::as, (bs, cs) => match p a with | true => loop as (a::bs, cs) | false => loop as (bs, a::cs); loop as ([], [])

pairs.name: List.toArrayMap
pairs.state:
l : List ℤ
f : ℤ → ℤ
⊢ Array ℤ
pairs.tactic: exact l.foldl (init := #[]) fun acc x => acc.push (f x)
